Based on a close examination of the top edge of the screenshot:

The answer is **(b) fully visible and stuck/pinned to the top of the screen**.

**Precise description of what is seen at the top edge:**
*   **No Clipping:** The very first row of cards (the four rounded squares at the top) is **completely intact**. You can see their full height, including the complete rounded corners at the top of each card.
*   **Pinned Position:** There is no visual indication that these cards have scrolled past the edge. They appear to be positioned at or near the absolute top of the container, with clear space (or the screen edge) visible above their top borders.
*   **Visual Evidence:** If the view were scrolled down as described in option (a), the top row would be sliced horizontally, showing only the bottom halves of those squares. Instead, all four rows of the grid are fully visible, suggesting this is either the top of the scrollable area or the content is pinned.
